metric_contract.corrected_primary: micro: sum tolerance-matched predicted/target skeleton hits and pixel denominators over the entire frozen validation population before P/R/F1
metric_contract.empty_tile_convention: historical per-tile zero-denominator P or R is 1, so both-empty scores 1 and one-sided-empty F1 is 0; corrected micro uses global counts and treats a zero denominator as 1 only when the opposite global total is also zero
metric_contract.historical: tile-macro: compute P/R/F1 independently per eligible validation tile, then average tiles equally
